name: Quizell – Quizzes, Forms, Product Recommendations & Funnels for WordPress
author: quizell

sections.description:
📄 Quizell WordPress Plugin – Description

Quizell is the ultimate tool for creating interactive product quizzes, lead generation forms, and smart funnels directly inside your WordPress site.
Whether you run an online store, a service business, or a content platform, Quizell helps you engage visitors, recommend products, and capture more leads with no coding required.

With a powerful drag-and-drop builder, you can design quizzes that feel natural and fun while driving measurable results for your business.
From product recommendation quizzes that boost ecommerce sales, to onboarding funnels that guide users step by step, to feedback forms and surveys that uncover customer insights — Quizell gives you everything you need to grow.

💡 Why Choose Quizell?

  • Product Quizzes for Ecommerce – Help visitors find the perfect product, increase conversions, and reduce decision fatigue.
  • Lead Generation Forms – Capture emails and customer data seamlessly to grow your marketing list.
  • Interactive Funnels – Build guided experiences that nurture prospects and increase trust.
  • No-Code, Easy Setup – Create and publish within minutes using our intuitive builder.
  • Beautiful, Responsive Design – Every quiz and form looks great on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Seamless Integrations – Connect to tools you already use: Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Shopify, WooCommerce, and more.

✨ With Quizell, you’re not just adding a plugin — you’re adding a complete conversion engine to your WordPress site.

Join thousands of businesses already using Quizell to:

  • Personalize shopping experiences with recommendation quizzes
  • Collect qualified leads with high-converting funnels
  • Understand customers with feedback and survey forms
  • Automate marketing workflows with CRM and email integrations
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP file from wp-admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload
  2. Click Activate on the next screen.
  3. Start creating quizzes and forms. Enjoy!
sections.faq:
Does Quizell work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! Quizell is designed to work seamlessly with any modern WordPress theme. Whether you’re using Astra, GeneratePress, Storefront, or a custom-built design, your quizzes and funnels will adapt beautifully.

Does Quizell work with other WordPress plugins?

Absolutely. Quizell integrates smoothly with major plugins, including WooCommerce, Elementor, WPBakery, and SEO tools. It also connects to marketing platforms like Mailchimp, Klaviyo, and HubSpot.

Can I create product recommendation quizzes with Quizell?

Yes! Product quizzes are one of Quizell’s most powerful features. You can set up logic-based questions that guide visitors toward the right products.

Do I need coding skills to use Quizell?

Not at all. Quizell is completely no-code. With our drag-and-drop builder, anyone can create professional quizzes, forms, and funnels in minutes.

Is Quizell mobile responsive?

Yes. Every quiz and form created with Quizell is fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Can I integrate Quizell with my email marketing or CRM?

Yes. Quizell integrates with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and many others. You can automatically sync leads and start nurturing them instantly.

Will Quizell slow down my site?

No. Quizell is lightweight and optimized for performance. All assets load efficiently to ensure your WordPress site remains fast and SEO-friendly.

Is there a free version of Quizell?

Yes! You can start with Quizell for free and explore the core features. For advanced logic, unlimited funnels, and integrations, you can upgrade to a paid plan anytime.
